notes.title: Update for August
notes.content:
Fixed:

-Rework all UI design and fonts
-Tutorial 
-Radio
-Mission list 
-Clipping of items
-Soldering mode
-Main menu bugs
-Several technical fixes and optimizations.
-Numerous bug fixes

Added:

-Sparks effect while soldering
-Mission brief and its separate table
-Mission name near mission parts list
-Joystick support in-game
-Change of color after the needed part is printed or destroyed
-Videos on computer screens near the launch button
-Volume slider in the options menu
-Sounds for printing, launching the rocket, explosion of the rocket, soldering sound, etc.
